spec.situation_desc: needs a replacement for a lost card

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Good morning, Thistle Bank, Zara speaking. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I'm Eilidh Achebe. I've lost my bank card and need a replacement.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I'm sorry to hear that, Eilidh. I can help you with the next steps. Before we get to that, I can see your current account balance is £684.27.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right, thanks. I haven't noticed any transactions I don't recognise.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thanks for letting me know. I'll just check your identity now. Could you tell me your date of birth and the first line of your address?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Thank you. And what's the postcode?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: That's all matched, thank you. Is the card definitely lost, rather than just misplaced?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: I'm pretty sure it's lost. I've checked my bag and at home.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Understood. I can talk you through reporting it lost and requesting a replacement. I'll first check the card details and available options with you.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: To summarise, you've told me the card is lost and you haven't seen any unrecognised transactions. We can go through the lost-card steps and the replacement options next. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Yes, it does. Thanks for explaining.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: You're welcome, Eilidh. Shall we go through those steps now?
